description: Self-drawing route lines on a map background — one or more SVG paths animated via stroke-dashoffset, with an optional base image displayed underneath. Built for the vox global-supply-chain scene where cyan routes draw themselves between regions.

routes.description: SVG path d-strings; each draws in sequence then glows.

imageSrc.description: optional base image (path relative to public/). When omitted, transparent background.

drawDurationFraction.description: fraction of the asset's active window each route spends drawing; multiple routes divide this between them

glowColorToken.description: color token for the secondary glow halo behind the drawn line

glowRadius.description: gaussian blur radius of the glow halo in px

texturePath.description: optional texture token from styles.textures, overlaid via mixBlendMode multiply
